M4_5_provides_to_M4_6.work_item: M4-6 GitHub Issue / Control-Comment Authority Adapter
receives_from_M4_5: Portable Plan Mutation Port contract (typed operation/target/correlation/contract/idempotency/intent + Subject+raw preconditions + candidate/normalized digests + authorization/lease ref)
Multi-domain precondition model (raw_source_revision + observed_raw_digest as external CAS distinct from Subject CAS and normalized digest)
Read-before-write contract and stale precondition fail-closed rule
At-most-one external attempt contract (PREPARED→APPLYING before write)
M4_6_owns: GitHub Issue number, comment ID, gh api / pagination / request plumbing
GitHub-specific optimistic concurrency mapping (raw_source_revision → etag/revision or Issue body revision)
Control-comment role resolution (required/optional roles, zero→missing fail closed, one→exact, many→duplicate fail closed; no first/newest selection)
GitHub-specific error/rate-limit/permission to FAILED_NO_EFFECT mapping where authoritative rejection is proven no-effect
M4_6_does_not_own: Port contract definition (already frozen in M4-5)
M4_5_provides_to_M4_6.parallel_safety: M4-6 and M4-7 can proceed in parallel after M4-5 plan acceptance, subject to source ownership reconnaissance on shared hot files (e.g., adapters/plan_authority/port.py is integration_only for downstream consumers; M4-6 writes only adapters/plan_authority/github.py and tests)

M4_5_provides_to_M4_7.work_item: M4-7 Durable External Mutation Journal + Reconciliation / Recovery
receives_from_M4_5: Mutation journal contract (states PREPARED..CONFLICT, required write order, journal fields, mandatory durability before external write)
Crash windows J1-J10 and stranded APPLYING reconciliation rule
Three-way reconciliation precedence and classification rules (candidate → VERIFIED_RECOVERED, original → RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT with fresh auth, third → CONFLICT, normalized equality supporting-only)
Retry authorization rule (UNKNOWN_OUTCOME_BLIND_LEASE_REUSE=no, RETRYABLE requires fresh auth+Subject+raw+new lease)
M4_7_owns: Durable journal store implementation (isolation, persistence, transaction boundary, ownership/lease for duplicate executor guard)
Deterministic reconciliation/recovery execution engine (read authority, classify observed, persist terminal state, surface CONFLICT/NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE)
Retry eligibility enforcement (fresh authorization validation before new attempt)
Duplicate executor reservation and recovery takeover rules
M4_5_provides_to_M4_7.parallel_safety: M4-7 writes core/journal/store.py and engine; reads port contract; shared journal/model files are integration_only - serialization required if both M4-6/M4-7 attempt to modify the same shared hot file

downstream_m4_8.work_item: M4-8 CLI/Core Convergence + M4-Owned Successor Regression Closure
downstream_m4_8.receives: Integrated M4-5 port + M4-6 GitHub adapter + M4-7 durable recovery
downstream_m4_8.thin_cli_projection: CLI is machine adapter, not semantic authority; CLI_IS_EXCLUSIVE_ENTRYPOINT=no

parallel_safety_plan.policy: Shared hot files remain integration_only; M4-6 and M4-7 may design interfaces in parallel (planning) but must not concurrently write the same hot file during implementation; integration via single owner per file, serialize or integration_only
